theme_and_art_direction.description: Deep navy ink, metallic gold accents, editorial serif display type paired with a refined sans. Emphasize a premium, secure, and trusted feel with purposeful motion.
global_rules: Use framer-motion scroll reveals and micro-interactions.
Commit to a single distinctive direction: deep navy ink and metallic gold.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, Editorial Marquee. Distinctive editorial serif for a premium legal chamber feel.

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI elements, data tables, form inputs. Refined, crisp sans for excellent legibility.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows on light backgrounds, 1px gold borders with low opacity (border-gold/20) on dark surfaces to define edges without soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on the deep navy sections to give it an 'ink' or physical paper quality.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use solid surfaces with crisp geometric clippings. Avoid heavy glassmorphism unless needed for sticky headers (then use highly saturated crystal glass with 1px border).

hero.description: Dark hero section with spotlight-treated circular navy/gold 'SP' logo emblem.
hero.motion: Kinetic masked line-by-line on-load reveal for typography. Subtle parallax/3D moment on the abstract background or logo.
hero.content: Tagline emphasizing rights, responsibility, secure & trusted.
hero.layout: Asymmetrical layout. Large serif heading left-aligned, emblem positioned prominently.

about_expertise.description: Asymmetrical layout with clipped/framed imagery (tall portrait ratio).
about_expertise.content: Details on legal expertise and professional presence.

services_pricing.layout: Dense, highly legible table. Do not use generic centered cards. Use a clean border-collapse style with subtle gold row separators.
services_pricing.key_info: Services starting ₹199 PAN India / $5 global. 100% fee refund guarantee. 24-hour delivery.

booking_form.description: Sleek, integrated booking form that saves to the DB.
booking_form.layout: Clean single column on a surface card with 1px gold border. Focus state outlines in metallic gold.
booking_form.functionality: Connected to backend API. Must show success/error toasts using Sonner.

csr_careers.description: Editorial section with large serif typography and structured negative space.
csr_careers.content: Highlighting Corporate Social Responsibility and Career opportunities.

why_choose_process.description: Process steps for 'How it works' and 'Why choose us'.
why_choose_process.layout: Vertical timeline or staggered bento grid (Mode A: 'Tetris' grid). No equal squares.

contact.description: Grid layout splitting contact info and payment details.

payment_info.description: UPI payment shown as static info with copyable UPI ID + real scannable QR code. (Design a premium UI representation of the QR code box).

editorial_marquee.description: Slow editorial marquee for brand values.
editorial_marquee.style: Serif font, pale gold text on navy background, wide spacing, very slow smooth drift. 'react-fast-marquee'.

footer.description: Massive footer with large brand typographic element.
footer.content: © 2026 SpLegalMart "Your Rights. Our Responsibility. Secure & Trusted."

floating_actions.description: Floating WhatsApp and Call buttons fixed to the bottom right. Premium metallic gold styling.

admin_panel.design: Clean, dense dashboard style. Mode B High Density Grid. Minimalist, using Shadcn components (tables, dialogs). Navy side-nav with gold active states.

motion_and_interaction.reveals: Framer motion staggered fade-ups (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1, duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]). Kinetic line-by-line mask reveals for main headings.
motion_and_interaction.hovers: Buttons subtle scale or background fill transition. Table rows highlight slightly on hover.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract textured background with blue and gold stripes (Use for Hero overlay or subtle parallax).

about_office.description: Modern architecture (glass building) for corporate presence in About section.

legal_scales.description: Statue of justice with scales on dark background. Clip this into an asymmetrical frame.

lawyer_portrait.description: Professional lawyer portrait for leadership or career section.

component_instructions.buttons: Sharp edges or minimal rounding (2px-4px). Background metallic gold, text deep navy. Hover state: slightly lighter gold.
component_instructions.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs. Dark mode: bg-transparent, border-gold/20, text-white, focus:border-gold.
component_instructions.tables: Use Shadcn Table. No outer card wrapping if possible, just the raw data structure with crisp borders.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use solid dark colors.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical 'Bento' or 'Tetris' grid styles for content sections.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Always use modern button styles (sharp or subtle rounding) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Ensure all components use `.js` and `.jsx` extensions, as the environment does not use TypeScript (`.tsx`).
